_doc: The Veilfalls (world-src/waterfalls), generated by the region author. A basalt plateau (70-95 m) breaks at an escarpment above the Willowrun lowland; the veilfalls_pool (overworld.json) sits in a near-vertical amphitheatre cut into it: a shelf at 22.4 m round the pool (r < 46), walls to the rim, two tall falls on the north wall fed by plateau rivers, a side gorge on the -x side with a cascade, a stepped fall and the rope bridge high over it, and a stepped ledge stair up the +x wall (seen from the pool looking north: stair and tall falls on the left, cascade and bridge on the right, as in docs/concepts/waterfalls.webp). A second fall drops off the +x terrace into the Lowveil pool. Chains of flatten circles make the ledges, gorge floors and anchor pads.
